mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which can lead to increased borrowing and investment, thus driving up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 20-day returns do not exceed the baseline return rate during periods of declining FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts reflects stronger consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 60-day returns do not improve following increased housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate indicates labor market weakness, which can negatively impact consumer spending and lead to lower S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 20-day returns do not decrease when unemployment exceeds 6%.

mechanism_narrative: Increased industrial production suggests economic growth, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 60-day returns do not improve with rising industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth combined with rising inflation indicates economic stress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth slows and CPIAUCSL rises
failure_condition: If S&P 500 20-day returns do not fall when GDP growth slows and inflation rises.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in federal funds rate increases borrowing costs, potentially leading to lower S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 5-day returns do not decrease when FEDFUNDS exceed 3%.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing employment growth indicates a weaker labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 20-day returns do not fall with slowing employment growth.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing retail sales combined with rising interest rates indicates reduced consumer spending and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth slows and FEDFUNDS rises
failure_condition: If S&P 500 60-day returns do not fall when retail sales slow and interest rates rise.
